Learn from how it reasoned step-by-step and solved the problem: # Refactoring WeatherMap for Per-Site Image Overlays **Session ID:** `1aeed28f-cc98-45f3-b086-4c42536e86ad` **Created:** 2026-04-02 22:09:19 UTC **Source:** `C:\Users\willa\AppData\Roaming\Code\User\workspaceStorage\5b0d94244ce85c8130543581445ff9c1\chatSessions\1aeed28f-cc98-45f3-b086-4c42536e86ad.jsonl` --- ## Turn 1 — 2026-04-02 22:10:28 UTC **User:** File: live-nexrad-weather/src/components/WeatherMap.tsx Goal: Replace the single shared canvas/toDataURL() compositing approach with per-site L.ImageOverlay instances. Each active radar site gets its own overlay, updated directly from the image cache. This eliminates the canvas scaling blur entirely. Step 1 — Add a new ref for per-site image overlays: Near the other refs (around line 388), add: TypeScript const siteImageOverlaysRef = useRef>(new Map()) Step 2 — Replace drawCanvas() with drawOverlays(): Delete the entire ensureCanvas() function and the entire drawCanvas() function. Replace them with this single drawOverlays() function: TypeScript const drawOverlays = () => { const map = mapRef.current if (!map) return const overlays = overlaysRef.current const siteImageOverlays = siteImageOverlaysRef.current // Remove overlays for sites no longer active siteImageOverlays.forEach((imageOverlay, siteName) => { if (!overlays.has(siteName)) { map.removeLayer(imageOverlay) siteImageOverlays.delete(siteName) } }) overlays.forEach((overlay, siteName) => { const result = getDisplayFrame(overlay) if (!result) return const { frame, index } = result overlay.displayedFrameIndex = index const img = imageCache.get(getRadarImageUrl(frame.filename)) if (!img || !img.complete || img.naturalWidth === 0) return const bounds = L.latLngBounds( L.latLng(frame.south, frame.west), L.latLng(frame.north, frame.east) ) const effectiveOpacity = getEffectiveRadarOpacity(radarOpacity, frame.ageSeconds) if (siteImageOverlays.has(siteName)) { const imageOverlay = siteImageOverlays.get(siteName)! imageOverlay.setUrl(img.src) imageOverlay.setBounds(bounds) imageOverlay.setOpacity(effectiveOpacity) } else { const imageOverlay = L.imageOverlay(img.src, bounds, { opacity: effectiveOpacity, interactive: false, zIndex: 400, }).addTo(map) siteImageOverlays.set(siteName, imageOverlay) } }) } Step 3 — Replace all calls to drawCanvas() with drawOverlays(): There are several places in the animation useEffect and the overlay management useEffect that call drawCanvas() or pendingDrawRef.current = true followed by drawCanvas(). Replace every one of those with just drawOverlays(). Also replace the call inside the ResizeObserver callback — change: TypeScript canvasElRef.current.width = 0 pendingDrawRef.current = true drawCanvas() to just: TypeScript drawOverlays() Step 4 — Remove canvas refs and state that are no longer needed: Remove these refs: TypeScript const canvasOverlayRef = useRef(null) const canvasElRef = useRef(null) const pendingDrawRef = useRef(false) Remove the useEffect that only updated canvas opacity: TypeScript useEffect(() => { if (canvasOverlayRef.current) { canvasOverlayRef.current.setOpacity(radarOpacity) } }, [radarOpacity]) Instead add a new useEffect that updates all per-site overlay opacities when radarOpacity changes: TypeScript useEffect(() => { siteImageOverlaysRef.current.forEach((imageOverlay) => { imageOverlay.setOpacity(radarOpacity) }) }, [radarOpacity]) Step 5 — Clean up per-site overlays on map destroy: In the map init useEffect cleanup (the return () => {} block), add cleanup for the site image overlays before the mapRef.current.remove() call: TypeScript siteImageOverlaysRef.current.forEach((imageOverlay) => { imageOverlay.remove() }) siteImageOverlaysRef.current.clear() Also remove the old canvas cleanup block: TypeScript if (canvasOverlayRef.current && mapRef.current) { mapRef.current.removeLayer(canvasOverlayRef.current) canvasOverlayRef.current = null } Step 6 — Clean up per-site overlays when sites are removed: In the overlay management useEffect, where sites that are no longer active are removed (the existingSites.forEach block that calls map.removeLayer(overlay.label)), also remove the image overlay for that site: TypeScript existingSites.forEach((siteName) => { if (!currentSites.has(siteName)) { const overlay = overlays.get(siteName)! map.removeLayer(overlay.label) // Also remove the image overlay const imageOverlay = siteImageOverlaysRef.current.get(siteName) if (imageOverlay) { map.removeLayer(imageOverlay) siteImageOverlaysRef.current.delete(siteName) } overlays.delete(siteName) } }) Step 7 — Remove the ResizeObserver since we no longer have a canvas to resize: Remove the entire ResizeObserver block that was added in the previous commit (the one observing mapContainerRef.current). It's no longer needed since each L.ImageOverlay is positioned by lat/lon bounds and scales automatically with the map. Step 8 — Remove CANVAS_BOUNDS and BBOX constants that are no longer used: Remove these constants since they were only used by the canvas compositing math: TypeScript const CANVAS_BOUNDS = L.latLngBounds(...) const BBOX_WEST = -135 const BBOX_EAST = -58 const BBOX_NORTH = 53 const BBOX_SOUTH = 18 const BBOX_LON_SPAN = BBOX_EAST - BBOX_WEST const BBOX_LAT_SPAN = BBOX_NORTH - BBOX_SOUTH const latToMercY = (lat: number) => ... const BBOX_MERC_NORTH = latToMercY(BBOX_NORTH) const BBOX_MERC_SOUTH = latToMercY(BBOX_SOUTH) const BBOX_MERC_SPAN = BBOX_MERC_NORTH - BBOX_MERC_SOUTH No other changes. All frame fetching, animation tick, preloading, geolocation, circulation/warning/SPC layers, VoronoiLayer, WindLayer — everything else stays exactly as-is.
